profile.headline: Software Developer at Energy Laboratories
profile.summary:
I am a motivated and dependable person who has completed a Bachelor’s degree in computer programming through DeVry University located in Federal Way, WA in June of 2011.

I have been working at AnswerNet, and have had many opportunities to further my knowledge and skills. Although I have successfully managed; as well as participated in multiple team projects at DeVry University. I tend to have a talent for quickly understanding technology and also strong in communication skills which reflect when I’m on the phone as well as in person. I excel in my projects and am usually ahead of the work schedule.
